summary: Chunk 1 (units 1-39): 10 errors, 35 minor. Errors: unsupported 'one'/'each' (4,10), unhedged disputed miśi (4,29), wrong gender/agreement on rasāyanam (6), missing 'conjectural reading' in 24 translations, wrong w 'paced' (26). Damaged-print units 9, 14, 29, 32, 34 carry 'conjectural reading' in both translations (Hindi wording tidied in 9, 14, 29); unit 24 did not and is patched. No identification judged wrong; hedging is the issue (miśi). Needs a human: 14 (paiṃḍhuṃthā), 19 (tenai), 29 (kara; karañja breaks the 16-syllable metre), 32 (dhmāna breaks metre and duplicates ādhmāna), 34 (aśmakuṇḍalān), 36 (pañcamūla agokṣura contradiction), 4 (attachment of quantities), 38 (yuktaṃ vs bastiḥ). Sentences run across 3-8, 5-7, 10-11, 18-20, 21-22, 23-29, 31-34, 36-39; no regrouping claimed (one could group 31-34 and 23-29 as single sentences for display). Hindi in the draft is thin on modern plant names (owner policy): patched for 4, 7, 17, 18, 19, 23, 24, 25, 29, 33, 36, 37; remaining plant Hindi names are suggestions.
glossary_suggestions: saindhava: Hindi 'सैन्धव यानी सेंधा नमक' at first use in a unit; sindhūttha similar.
miśi = 'probably dill (Anethum sowa)' in both languages wherever it appears; Hindi 'मिशि यानी सम्भवतः सोया'.
Measures: akṣa, picu, karṣa are standard synonyms of the same weight (karṣa); prasṛta = 2 pala; prastha, āḍhaka volumes; keep generic in translation, give the equivalence once in notes.

pañcamūla: lesser (kanīya/laghu) = śālaparṇī, pṛśniparṇī, bṛhatī, kaṇṭakārī, gokṣura; greater = bilva, agnimantha, śyonāka, pāṭalā, gambhārī; dvipañcamūla = both groups (daśamūla). Add a note only where the text says which.
Do not supply numerals ('one') or distributives ('each') when the Sanskrit has none (karṣaḥ, āḍhake, pālikam).
Hindi: no brackets even for 'conjectural reading'; use 'अनुमानित पाठ के अनुसार' in the sentence.
A rejected typo conjecture belongs in text_flags; the corrected form goes in w only when the flag is 'possible' and plausible; unrestorable words stay as printed in w.
